posts.name: MrLeRobot
posts.cooked:
Take out Nightmist's deck and look at the "Mists of Time" card. Notice the guy who looks like some kind of human shaped galaxy, holding the Earth in his right hand? Yeah, just above Legacy's death scene. Ok, now look at Christopher's "Admin" forum badge. Same guy. Never realized that... Perhaps it's old news, but I never read anything about this particular detail. Anyone else think it's the final boss?

 

Also, on the same card AND on the "Admin" forum badge, there is another figure. At first I thought it was similar to akash (4 red eyes, brownish skin tone), but I'm not entirely sure of that now... Taking a closer look, it looks like it might be the face of akash covering like 1/4 of the earth, the picture being viewed from space or something...

 

If you have more info, please let me know!
